fields.title: 📖 Mujāhid: Ibrāhīm was a believer alone
fields.body:
🖋️ **Mujāhid ibn Jabr** said about Allah’s statement that Ibrāhīm was an Ummah:

***“He was a believer alone, while the people at that time were all Kuffār.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The truth of **Tawḥīd** does not depend on the majority. Ibrāhīm was alone upon Īmān and Tawḥīd, while his surroundings were in Kufr and Shirk. This is a general judgment upon the religious state of a time, not the thoughtless application to specific individuals without conditions.

immutable.source: 📝 Tafsīr Ibn Kathīr zu Sūrat an-Naḥl 16:120; dort wird von Mujāhid überliefert: Ibrāhīm war eine Ummah, also allein gläubig, während die Menschen zu jener Zeit Kuffār waren.
